about: Cargo 3's story: from 2533, just after the Great Debacle, over several centuries of external time. Written in the files under cargo3/; tools/build_story.py builds them, with the names from saga.json, into cargo3.game.json, which the game reads.

stockmarket_everywhere.about: 1 when every planet, asteroid base and outpost has a stock market

controlled_locations.about: locations marked controlled_by_player (nothing in the game sets this)

best_cabin.about: comfort level of the best passenger cabin aboard

turns_since_vip.about: turns since the last VIP passenger appeared

crew_size.about: helpers hired (the ship has bunks for four)

hansa_bonds.about: Hansa bonds held (each lowers the convoy dues)

dues_arrears.about: convoy dues owed and not yet paid

hull_class.about: the ship's hull: 0 the old hauler, 1 Ironback, 2 Farstrider

hold_free.about: free room in the hold for dry goods, after special cargo

cargo.tech.about: tech in the hold (an effect adds or takes it)

cargo.agri.about: agri in the hold (an effect adds or takes it)

cargo.salt.about: salt in the hold (an effect adds or takes it)

cargo.fuel.about: fuel in the hold (an effect adds or takes it)

buildings.Agrobot Assembly Line.about: Agrobot Assembly Line buildings, all locations

standing.hansa.about: standing with the Hauler Hansa, -100 to 100 (an effect moves it)

standing.mandate.about: standing with the Terran Mandate, -100 to 100 (an effect moves it)

standing.concord.about: standing with the Stellar Concord, -100 to 100 (an effect moves it)

dawn_trust.about: the Binary Dawn's trust, -100 to 100, hidden from the player (an effect moves it)

code.about: game code the tools cannot read
